name: Wise Cursor
summary: An assisted 3D selection technique for mouse-driven serious games that estimates which object the user intended to select and supports clarification when the intended target is uncertain.
howItWorks: When the user clicks in the 3D environment, the system computes a set of candidate objects and estimates the probability that each one is the intended target. If one candidate is sufficiently likely, it is selected; otherwise, the system asks the user to clarify the selection.
advantages: Improving accessibility and usability in 3D serious games, especially for users who are not experienced with first-person 3D interaction.
limitations: The technique depends on the quality of the candidate-ranking model. When the system's probability estimate does not match the user's intention, an additional clarification step may be needed.
